headline: Tiempo de Turbulencia
content: con la intención de las dos agrupaciones de izquierda presentadas en el Congreso de reimpulsar la invacancia del presidente Pedro Pablo Kuczyski, por sus pasados nexos laborales con Odebrecht y por el indulto a Alberto Fujimori, entraremos lamentablemente a una etapa de turbulencia política generada por el mismo mandatario, quién en diciembre último se salv— contra todo pronóstico— de ser enviado a su casa, tras un acuerdo bajo la mesa con un sector del fujimorismo. Tenemos también que considerar que para finales de este mes está prevista la declaración ante el ministerio público de Jorge Barata, quien fuera en el Perú el hombre fuerte de la empresa constructora brasileña Odebrecht. headline: Helado inspirado en el Pisco Sour

Desde entonces, y en honor a la paz que tanto se anhelaba en aquel tiempo, nace este simpático local donde se puede disfrutar lo mejor de la cocina contemporánea, además de fusión peruano-francesa-europea. Ana María Buscosen, creadora del postre, dijo algunos detalles sobre la elaboración. Para transformarlo en helado mantuve los mismos ingredientes y las medidas exactas del cóctel.

headline: Absolución sorprendente

headline: Intervinen a ocho personas con más de 16 kilos de droga en Yungay
content: Agentes del Departamento Antidrogas de la Región Ancash detuvieron a ocho sujetos que transportaban 16 kilos y medio de pasta básica de cocaína, en la provincia de Yungay. Según el coronel de la Policía Nacional del Perú de la Región Ancash, José Zárraga, la droga se encontraba en botellas y estaba camuflada en mochilas. El agente también indicó que los sujetos iban a bordo de dos vehículos, para evitar levantar sospechas. Todos fueron trasladados al Departamento Antidrogas de Chimbote.

headline: REGISTROS A MAINTAIN PROTEST UNTIL FEBRUARY 23 OVER POTATO PRICES
content: Three regions have suspended their protests temporarily to analyze agreements made with MINAGRI. The agreement was signed last Thursday between the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation and the National Commission of Potato Producers (CONAPOPO). Rubén La Bautista, leader of the potato growers’ union in Ayacucho, announced that his region would resume its strike on February 23 while farmers from Andahuaylas await responses from the government before returning to the streets.

headline: ARMIES TO BUY SURPLUS FROM DISCONTENTED AGRICULTURALISTS
content: Defense Minister Jorge Kisic ordered the Armed Forces to purchase potatoes from producers who had surplus production, supporting agreements established between the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation and the National Commission of Potato Producers (CONAPOPO), which were agreed upon last Thursday. According to the Defense Ministry, these potatoes will serve as ingredients for military personnels meals across various national defense establishments. The amount of potatoes purchased and where it will occur will be determined shortly through coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture.

headline: NEW VICEMINISTRY CHANGES AMID STRIKE POLITICS AND THE PRESSURE ON PRESIDENTIAL STABILITY
content: The Ministry of Agriculture appointed two new vice ministers amid ongoing strikes by potato producers nationwide. Pablo Benites resigned after accepting thanks for services rendered until now, according to Supreme Resolution No. 2018-MINAGRI, allowing Jorge Luis Maiquelón Quintana to take over Development and Agricultural Infrastructure and Irrigation within the ministry. Meanwhile, political pressure mounts against President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski due to alleged links between his company, Westfield Capital, and Brazilian construction giant Odebrecht. Hector Becerril criticized the president’s delay in addressing Congress about these allegations under the Lava Jato commission inquiry initiated December 22.

headline: LEFT-WING GROUP SEIZES ALLIANCE OPPORTUNITIES FOR IMPEACHMENT MOVEMENT AGAINST PPKE
content: New Peru, led by Verónica Mendoza, began discussions yesterday with different parliamentary forces aiming to gain support for impeachment proceedings against President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski. They argue he should leave office permanently because of permanent moral incompetence linked to connections between his sole proprietorship, Westfield Capital, and Odebrecht. While waiting for a response from Apra, New Peru has already held meetings with both Action Populaire and Force Majority, discussing potential alliances despite differing views regarding former President Fujimoris pardon being included as grounds for removal.

headline: KENJIS LEGISLATORS SEEK MIXED BANK ACCOUNT FORMATION POST-LAW OF SHUTTING UP TRIAL DECISION
content: Following unsuccessful attempts to impeach President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski based on claims of moral inability promoted by left-wing parties like New Peru and Broad Front, legislators aligned with Kenji Fujimori started forming a mixed bank account group using Article 37 paragraph six of the Congressional Regulation amended September 15, 2017. This move does not incur additional costs for Congress but faces opposition since members claim resignation reasons dont qualify them for such formation given prior expulsion circumstances related to internal party regulations violations during voting processes.
